name: upy-wiring-plugin
description: Workflow plugin phase for generating MicroPython wiring artifacts from generated firmware and manifest data.

interface.shortDescription: Generates wiring diagrams and pin tables after firmware generation.
interface.longDescription: Consumes upy-generate-plugin phase_complete manifest_content and generated firmware files, derives docs/wiring.json, validates the wiring schema, renders Markdown, HTML, SVG, PNG, and pin cross-reference artifacts, then emits a wiring phase_complete without changing the main deploy chain.
defaultPrompt: Run wiring from a generate phase_complete.
Generate wiring diagrams for a MicroPython project.
Validate wiring artifacts and pin tables.
